turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
Hello! For regular verbs in the past simple, we add -ed. Example: I played football. If the verb ends in e, add only -d (like danced).

Exercise: Write the past form: Yesterday I ___ (play) football.
